Class ParameterExtractors

java.lang.Object
org.jboss.resteasy.core.extractors.ParameterExtractors
public class ParameterExtractors extends Object
Factory for RequestParameterExtractor instances. Provides a unified entry point that dispatches by annotation type, as well as individual factory methods for each Jakarta REST parameter annotation (@CookieParam, @FormParam, @HeaderParam, @MatrixParam, @PathParam, @QueryParam).
Author:
James R. Perkins

    • of

      public static RequestParameterExtractor of(Class<?> injectionType, Type genericType, Set<Annotation> annotations, boolean encode, String paramName, String defaultValue, Class<? extends Annotation> annotationType, ResteasyProviderFactory factory)
      Creates a RequestParameterExtractor for the given annotation type by dispatching to the appropriate forXxxParam method.
      Parameters:
      injectionType - the target type to convert to
      genericType - the generic type of the injection point
      annotations - all annotations on the injection point
      encode - true if the parameter value should be URL-encoded
      paramName - the parameter name as declared in the annotation, or derived from the injection point
      defaultValue - the default value when the parameter is absent, or null
      annotationType - the parameter annotation type (e.g. PathParam.class)
      factory - the provider factory for converter lookups
      Returns:
      the extractor for the given parameter
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the annotation type is not supported
